claims: The NASA Artemis II mission carried four astronauts.
The NASA Artemis II mission was a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The NASA Artemis II mission successfully lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The crew of the NASA Artemis II mission includes astronauts from NASA and the Canadian Space Agency.
The NASA Artemis II mission marks the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
The launch vehicle for the NASA Artemis II mission is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft.
The mission goal of the NASA Artemis II mission is a test flight of systems for future lunar landings.
The Orion capsule is scheduled for a trans-lunar injection maneuver.
The launch broadcast can be rewatched via NASA's YouTube channel.
